description: Org directory entries (docs/org-directory.md §2). entries: canonicalOrgDirectoryEntryBody(entry) == body; orgDirectoryEntryKey(directoryKey, orgId, entryId, keyVersion) == entryKeyHex; sealOrgDirectoryEntry with the 12-byte nonce in sealedHex[0..24) == sealed; canonicalOrgDirectoryWrite(sealed) == write; openOrgDirectoryEntry(sealed, directoryKey) == entry. opens: must throw. badBodies: parseOrgDirectoryEntryBody must throw. newest: openOrgDirectory keeps the newer updatedAt per seat. connectors: canonicalOrgConnector == connectorBytes, verifyOrgConnector with org-authority chain v0..v1 and server home at connector.issuedAt; proposals: canonicalOrgProposal == bytes, verifyOrgProposal(connector, bundle, {rolesHash, now}); openOrgProposal for each admin (X-Wing seed kemSeedHex) == payload; decision bytes.

entries.name: a seat named by hand (a pipe and a comma in the display name)
an LDAP seat with many groups (a larger bucket), key version 2

opens.name: the header names another key version

badBodies.name: a control character in the pseudonym

newest.name: two entries for one seat: the newer updatedAt wins, whatever order they arrive in
